answer: Locks are written down in juniper, expire in terrace, and lagoon lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 30 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An farming party running 25 aliases therefore needs 192 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 133 dollars in locked collateral and another 1 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
